sonnet.problem: The card says his eyes are "worn out from watching so long." Psalm 119:123 only says "My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation." The text gives no length of time and no reason for the failing eyes, so "so long" adds both.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The true/false statement joins two separate claims: the LORD's righteousness is everlasting, and His law is true. It should test only one.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.
